label: token right after an early r (r at position 0 or 1)
explanation: Fires in the original phase at step 1 or 2 when the previous input was r, i.e. on the token immediately following an r at original position 0 or 1. Strongest (~0.95-1.0 of max) at t=1 when the sequence starts with r; weaker (~0.4-0.67) at t=2 after r at position 1. Predicate has precision 1.0 on dev; misses are weak low-quartile activations at t=1-2 after k or f (and a few at t=3). Does not fire after an r later in the sequence, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase (13 copy-phase activations of 36720). Current token identity barely matters.

issues: The misses are about 3.5k steps with activations of roughly 0.00 of max. They hold 0.0% of activation mass on both dev and test. Most are at t=1 after an initial k (prev_tok==k & t<=2 has precision 0.084 and mass recall about 1e-6), with a few after f. They form a pattern, but at near-zero magnitude this is threshold noise and does not count as a real counterexample class.

Magnitude claims hold. On test, r at t=1 has precision 1.0, mass recall 0.638, and covers 82-100% of the top two activation quartiles. r at t=2 has precision 1.0, mass recall 0.361, and covers the lower and middle quartiles.
No firing after a later r: prev_tok==r & phase==0 & t>=3 has precision 0.0026 and mass recall 0.0004. There are 0 delimiter activations and 13 copy-phase activations out of 36720, as claimed.
The test split has 0 false positives. Precision 1.0, recall 0.904, F1 0.95 and mass recall 1.0 are confirmed. The label matches the predicate and does not overclaim.
